figuren.name: Kapitän Restanspruch

auszuege: TOP LEFT: squat broad barrel-shaped veteran pirate captain, huge battered black tricorn with thick sculpted ivory skull ornament, ragged burgundy shoulder cape.
Thick goo hand grips a short curved cutlass with chunky shell-shaped brass guard, another cradles battered rum jug with cork; swaggering snarling old sea dog, not laughing.

figuren.prompt_auszug: TOP LEFT: squat broad barrel-shaped veteran pirate captain, huge battered black tricorn with thick sculpted ivory skull ornament, ragged burgundy shoulder cape. One eye covered by plain leather patch, other WHITE sclera red iris black pupil half-lidded suspiciously; mouth clenched lopsided underbite with THREE uneven gold/ivory teeth. Thick goo hand grips a short curved cutlass with chunky shell-shaped brass guard, another cradles battered rum jug with cork; swaggering snarling old sea dog, not laughing.
